rationale: Structure check shows no derivatives or integrals and the relation is explicitly solvable for s_mix, so this is an explicit static map, not an ODE. Per the explicit freedom decision, preserve declared sampled inputs x and confinement_strength as variables and keep accessibility_scale, cooperative_accessibility, and heterogeneity_weight fixed as parameters. The chosen x range avoids the logarithmic singular endpoints at 0 and 1 while still sampling dilute, shoulder, and near-equimolar compositions densely enough to resolve curvature. The confinement_strength range includes the parent-recovery limit at 0 and several moderate nonzero conditions up to 4, which is strong enough to visibly suppress entropy without driving every condition into near-complete saturation. Parameter values accessibility_scale=12, cooperative_accessibility=8, heterogeneity_weight=6 keep the denominator positive and finite, activate the intended composition-dependent confinement relief, and make the heterogeneous late-stage recovery near x=1/2 visible while not erasing shoulder suppression. The intended distinguishing condition is comparison of s_mix versus x across multiple nonzero confinement_strength values: the curve remains symmetric in x↔1-x, peaks at x=1/2, and under stronger confinement exhibits flatter intermediate-composition shoulders with sharper recovery only near equimolar composition than the lower-generation models with a single smoother recovery phase. Weak/inactive limit: at confinement_strength=0 all confinement-mediated refinements are inactive and the ideal mixing entropy is exactly recovered, so this slice serves as a built-in reference rather than a contrast-bearing condition.
